notes.title: Update - 27.03.23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]The main menu has been completely redesigned.
[*]Added Mouse Invert and Mouse Sensitivity.
[*]Changed cursor.
[*]Added new characters Azazel and Seraphim.

[i]When examining the skeleton of one of the maids, a bottle of wine can be found in the wine cellar. Having drunk from it, the hero will return to an altered dream, in which he will have to choose the Dark or Light side, or simply return to the mansion.

At the moment - the choice has no significant result. In the future, the choice will affect the alternate ending and additional sex scenes with the Succubus and the Maid.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Update - 24.02.23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new character (Maid).
[*]Added rain.
[*]Added 5 magazines.
[*]Added a new achievement (Find all 10 magazines).
[*]Added a new playable location (Sleep).
[*]Added health system. When having sex with spirits, health will be taken away, 25% after normal sex and 10% after "Exile". To restore health, you need to drink elixirs, which can be found in the mansion and obtained from the maid.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - 03.01.23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]A new character has been added - the cunning Baron of the mansion, who loves men.
[*]Gradually, a system of random meetings of the character with the "inhabitants" of the mansion will be introduced. It can be both a loving and aggressive meeting.
[*]A magazine has been added, which currently has 5 images.
[*]The cursor has been slightly changed.
[*]Added icons of a cross and a flashlight to the HUD.
[*]Added German and French languages.
[*]Improved map.
[*]Fixed bug with overlapping menu.
[/list]
